posts.author: Colindosh
posts.body:
HI! This is my first post here but i need some help with something!
In my game i want to use images for the talking sprites instead of just the talking faces (kinda like in corpse party)
My question is—how could i have the images used be animated? The person working on the talking sprites for me made them animated and i’m wondering how i’d do this!
Any help appreciated!

posts.author: Angy1910
posts.body:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/animated-busts-and-picture-based-animations.79700/
^^^
This plugin works with MZ if you use the FOSSIL plugin.
You just have to  put FOSSIL the top of the plugin list. You can get the FOSSIL plugin for the latest version of RPG Maker MZ from this post by Aesica:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...mz-300-plugins-fossilized.135523/post-1500460
